bibliographic.title: Castle Doomstone
bibliographic.author: Strangelander
bibliographic.description:
Play Castle Doomstone Online (temporary location)
Download the Twine source (.tws) (temporary location)

Castle Doomstone is a fantasy Twine example game. It's a short, funny adventure written with kids and beginning Twine writers in mind. It has two puzzles and a few other features, but only uses three kinds of Twine links:
[[basic links]]
[[named links|destination]]
<<display 'passage'>>

Twine is an application that allows anyone to write a story game on Mac or Windows, and can be downloaded at twinery.org.

Play Castle Doomstone online, then download the .tws source file above (right-click and "Save Link As...") and open it in Twine to see how Castle Doomstone was made, and how you can use links to create a fun story game yourself.
